name: The Dropper ✨ [130+ LEVELS!]
desc:
Welcome to one of the first dropper games on Roblox! This game was inspired by a Minecraft map called The Dropper.

👉 Created by: https://www.roblox.com/groups/7291819/Lilly-Pop-Productions 👈

ALL LEVELS ARE POSSIBLE

✅Levels and skip stages save!

The objective of this game is to reach the bottom of each level while avoiding obstacles, and the levels get increasingly harder as you level up. New maps are always being added. Please note that this experience contains mild flashing colors and lights. Total levels: 136

✨UPDATE 02/06/2026:
⚡️ 3 new levels: Waffle Land, Bloxy Cola, and Construction
⚡️ Renovated some beginning levels

If you encounter any issues please post them on our group wall so they can be fixed!

Good luck and have fun falling your way to victory 🏆

The Dropper Rainbow Obby Platformer Free Fall Game
